message:
docs(update): split "not inline" from "does not block"

They were in one paragraph, which lets the confirmed half carry the
unverified one. Written as two statements now: the wait provably runs on its
own thread, owning the handles -- and whether the window keeps answering
while it does is not asserted anywhere.

Also recorded why the obvious test is not worth writing: "starting a thread
returns immediately" tests std::thread, and would be green while saying
nothing about the product.
